name: Mount Paektu
story: Mount Paektu is an active stratovolcano on the Chinese-North Korean border. At 2,744 m tall, it is the tallest mountain in North Korea and Northeast China, featuring a caldera that contains Heaven Lake. The mountain is covered in snow about eight months of the year.
matters: The mountain range is a known habitat for Siberian tigers, Asian black bears, Mongolian wolves, and wild boars. It supports a population of scaly-sided mergansers and preserves ancient forest characteristics of the Tertiary plant community.
